parsed.rationale: Both records carry is_test=false and is_mock=false per their context_flags, so the formal restraint-marker rules do not trigger. However, both files reside under Tests/ directories (Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift and WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift) and the type name MockDiscogsEntityResolver bears the canonical Mock prefix, indicating these are intentional, parallel test-double implementations scoped to their respective test targets (Metadata and app:iOS). Extracting a shared mock into a common production or test-support package would couple two independent test suites and risk leaking test semantics into shared infrastructure. The duplication is structurally coincidental given the likely miscalibration of the is_mock/is_test flags, and no production refactor is warranted.
